principles.title: Assume Breach
principles.statement: No security control is assumed to be absolutely safe. Always ask: if this control fails, what is the next line of defense?

principles.title: Least Privilege
principles.statement: Every subject (user, service, database, CI/CD, cloud IAM) is granted only the minimum privilege it requires.

principles.title: Zero Implicit Trust
principles.statement: Client, browser, mobile app, desktop app, internal network, third-party API, webhook, AI model output, user-supplied files, request headers, and internal services are never trusted automatically.

principles.title: Defense in Depth
principles.statement: No single security mechanism is relied upon. Controls are layered, e.g. input validation, parameterized query, least-privilege DB account, data encryption, key isolation, monitoring.

principles.title: Fail Secure
principles.statement: An error must never resolve toward disabling a security control. An authentication server error must reject the request, never allow it unauthenticated.

principles.title: Verifiable Security
principles.statement: A control being applied is not enough; it must be verifiable. Requirement, Verification, and Evidence must all exist together.

principles.title: Risk-based Security
principles.statement: Not every project is forced through the same controls. Applicable scope is determined by risk level and attack surface.

antiPatterns.wrongAssumption: 95% of all checklist items PASS, therefore the system is safe.
antiPatterns.correctAssumption: Completion rate does not equal security level.

antiPatterns.wrongAssumption: The security scanner reported zero findings, therefore there are no vulnerabilities.
antiPatterns.correctAssumption: A scanner's silence is not proof of absence.

antiPatterns.wrongAssumption: A WAF is installed, therefore SQL injection is safe.
antiPatterns.correctAssumption: A compensating control does not eliminate the underlying defect.

antiPatterns.wrongAssumption: The admin button is hidden from the UI, therefore the admin function is protected.
Encryption is applied, therefore sensitive data is safe.
antiPatterns.correctAssumption: If the key is exposed at the same point as the data, the protection is limited.

layers.name: Prevent
layers.purpose: Lower the probability of a successful attack.

layers.name: Detect
layers.purpose: Detect an attack or anomalous behavior.

layers.name: Contain & Recover
layers.purpose: Limit blast radius and recover after a breach.

layers.name: Assurance
layers.purpose: Verify that security controls actually work.

finalPrinciple.statement: The goal is a system where the failure of one security control does not lead to full system compromise.
